title: What is the ASP.NET Core MVC request lifecycle?
description: Understand how an HTTP request flows through ASP.NET Core MVC.

data.text: **Question:** What is the ASP.NET Core MVC request lifecycle?
An ASP.NET Core MVC request flows through: Routing → Middleware → Controller Selection → Action Execution → Result Execution → Response. Each stage has extension points via filters and middleware.

**1. Routing:**
- URL matched to a route pattern
- Route values extracted (controller, action, id)

**2. Middleware Pipeline:**
- Request passes through middleware components
- Authentication, authorization, logging, etc.
- Ends at MVC middleware

**3. Controller Selection & Action Execution:**
- Controller activator creates controller instance
- Action selector finds the action method
- Model binding creates action parameters
- Action filters run before/after action

**4. Result Execution:**
- Action returns an IActionResult
- Result filters run before/after result
- View result renders view to response
